name: Knight of Xoroth: Xorothian Warsteed mounts inside Blackfathom Deeps
contract: Xorothian Warsteed (804703) is the Knight of Xoroth's combat mount; Dreadrider's Stomp (804702) and
Hellfire Trample (804704) require it. Blackfathom Deeps (map 48) is a 5-player dungeon with
instance_template.allowMount = 0, where Spell::CheckCast refused 804703 with SPELL_FAILED_NO_MOUNTS_ALLOWED
(83). Like the Tinker Mechsuit helper, the Warsteed is allowed for a Knight of Xoroth in non-raid dungeons.

steps.label: SETUP the knight is in Blackfathom Deeps
SETUP the knight knows Xorothian Warsteed
The knight summons the Warsteed inside the dungeon
CONTRACT the Warsteed is mounted inside the dungeon
CONTRACT the cast was not refused with SPELL_FAILED_NO_MOUNTS_ALLOWED
